Um, guys, we'll do a short  look back on today and then  
we'll embargo some stuff until 7 p.m. on Monday. 
Philippe what's your take on that one today? Oh! No fighting.
That is a well-deserved victory, but you want to  score more goals. You want to entertain the fans  
also more than we did. A quite special game also,  hitting four times the crossbar — doesn’t happen  
so much. But, um, we had to be more clinical in  moments, for sure, in the second half. In the  
first half, it can be difficult to find the spaces  because they defend with a lot of numbers really  
low, spaces are small. We still had our chances  there. You come out of the dressing room in a good  
way. We could give some tweaks during halftime  about where to find spaces. You score directly,  
and then you should score the second  goal, and then you kill the belief more.
Now, the opponent stays in the game in a way  until the last second because something can  
fall out of the sky — that you get a chance  against and you can concede a goal because  
that can always happen in football. But the  positive thing is that we didn’t give away  
real chances. Jack Butland didn’t  have to make one real save today,  
but we should have scored a second and third  goal to kill the belief. That’s what you want,  
and we wanted to entertain the fans also  more than we did by scoring more goals.
Just given the fact that a lot of the  focus this week wasn’t on the football,  
how good was it to be able to come in, get  that victory, and move up to second place?
Yeah, but I don’t like excuses. I spoke in the  beginning of the week with the team about that.  
It’s about looking forward now, so it’s about  taking the three points. We could have scored,  
we should have scored more goals, and  now to look forward to our next game.
A few weeks ago, second place  seemed far off. Does it feel quite  
significant that you’ve now reached that target?
No, it’s not a target. I told you guys, and  maybe you don’t believe me, but it’s about us,  
what we do. And I’m convinced that we can  make a good season in that way if we focus  
on ourselves and not on other teams. Like we  didn’t do in that period. It’s about us taking  
the points and not looking at other teams. So we  will continue in that way, making the team better,  
progressing, and taking more points than we did  in the first couple of months because it was not  
enough. We all know that, we all knew that. So we  want to make a better second part of the season.
Jack Butland had to leave early.  Is there anything to worry about?
You don’t have to worry about him.  It’s because of private reasons that  
he had to leave very suddenly. He  will be back for the next game.
You’ve spoken a lot about consistency of  performance. It feels like you’re now getting  
it consistently. That was another good performance  today. I know what you say about the final third,  
but you must be pleased at least getting  into those positions. Maybe if you get that  
right, games could end up with another comfortable  scoreline, like today felt it could have been.
Yes, and it’s about creating stability in  that way. It’s normal with a new squad that,  
in the beginning, we started to work from the back  — how to build from there — then to the midfield,  
and finally to the final third. You need to do  that step by step; you cannot do everything at  
the same time with a team. We’re getting better  consistency in the squad, and it’s more clear for  
everybody what to do together in every situation,  in every moment, in all the different situations  
that you can have in football. You get more  stability in that way, but you need time for that.
We’re not at the end of learning and making  things better. I saw a lot of things we could  
do better today. That’s our job again, with all  the staff, to speak about that with the players,  
to show them that, and to do it in a  better way against St. Mirren. Of course,  
it’s never a linear line where it goes better  and better and better. The more you show things  
and the more you do things, that’s the same  with every team in the world. But our basics  
are stronger now than they were two months ago.  That’s a normal thing. Now it’s about keeping  
these basics strong all the time and improving  all the details around to make them better.
title: Philippe Clement FULL Post Match Press Conference | Rangers 1-0 Dundee
